name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods: usage bar with forecast, safety guards, YAML prompt shortcuts, context guard, model router and notifications.

plugins.name: bash-guard
plugins.description: Blocks destructive Bash commands and asks before risky ones

plugins.name: context-guard
plugins.description: Warns when the context passes 80% and offers to compact

plugins.name: focus-mode
plugins.description: /focus-dir <dir> restricts Claude's file edits to one folder

plugins.name: loop-guard
plugins.description: Stops Claude when it repeats a failing command or rewrites the same file in a loop

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Sends short questions to a lighter model to save quota

plugins.name: prompt-shortcuts
plugins.description: Slash-command shortcuts for prompts you type often

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Blocks access to secret files and asks before commands that print secrets

plugins.name: sound-events
plugins.description: Notifies (bell or desktop) when a command is blocked or a question waits for you

plugins.name: token-usage
plugins.description: Band above the prompt showing 5-hour and weekly rate-limit usage

plugins.name: turn-notify
plugins.description: Desktop notification when a long turn finishes
